description: Per-finding fusion weights of fuse_findings (p_final = logistic(intercept + w . x)). Refitted 2026-11-22 after the Phase 1 restructure (RAG = similarity to known cases only, so static and RAG are independent channels; detector-only units are classified in Phase 1) by logistic regression (w_static, w_rag, w_corroborated >= 0; L2 = 1) on the local findings of the 1,110 real functions of the v12 val+test split (label = the function's label; kaggle_ds2 synthetic excluded). tau_agent maximises F2 (recall-first) of 'reaches the Fixer'. 5-fold x 3 CV: old design refit recall 0.814 / FPR 0.253 / F2 0.781, new design 0.819 / 0.252 / 0.786; functions reaching the Fixer with the true SWC 6.5% -> 32.4%. Scripts and results: data/results/heuristics_tuning_v2/.
